en-US.longDescription:
The Outlook plugin will enable you to send files from Microsoft Outlook 2010-2021. Microsoft Outlook for Windows coming with Office 365 subscription is also supported.
Important: This is NOT an Office 365 plugin; as such, it is not supported in Outlook for Web, OWA, and "new" Outlook for Windows.
en-US.name: LiquidFiles OutlookPlugin

zh-CN.description: 从 Microsoft Outlook 发送文件
zh-CN.longDescription:
Outlook 插件允许您从 Microsoft Outlook 2010-2021 版本发送文件。同时兼容通过 Office 365 订阅提供的 Windows 版 Microsoft Outlook。
重要说明：本插件并非 Office 365 专用插件，因此不支持 Outlook 网页版、OWA 以及 Windows 版 Outlook (new)。
